listing.title: Carnation and Snowdrop Shirt, Watercolor Birth Flower Tee, Birth Month Flower Shirt, Winter Birthday Gift, Floral Bouquet Tee
listing.description: A hand-tied winter bouquet painted in watercolor: ruffled carnations in rose pink, coral red, blush and magenta with five white snowdrops arching between them, each bell with its green mark, plus round eucalyptus leaves and a pink satin bow, under "Carnation & Snowdrop" in painted script. Carnation and snowdrop are the two birth flowers traditionally given for January, so it's a gift for a January birthday, or for anyone who loves winter flowers. Gold sparkles, pale blue snowflakes and a small pink heart sit around the bouquet.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-23 (before any art): web searches '"JANUARY" trademark clothing t-shirts class 25 registered brand', 'JANUARY trademark Chang Wei-En clothing USPTO serial' and '"carnation and snowdrop" OR "carnation & snowdrop" trademark shirt'. Found a pending US application for the word JANUARY in class 25 (serial 90543337, filed 2021-02-24, published 2024-03-12, owner Chang, Wei-En; markinton.com aggregator, last updated 2026-04-11) and its Australian registration through the Madrid system (class 25). So 'January' is kept off the art, and off the tee and sweatshirt titles and tags (class 25); the mug, print and sticker listings (classes 21 and 16) use 'January birth flower' only as a plain description of which month's flowers these are, never as a brand. No record or brand for CARNATION AND SNOWDROP or CARNATION & SNOWDROP; the art lettering names the two flowers. Aggregator and search pages, not TSDR; tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions, so the owner can confirm in USPTO Trademark Search before listing. No florist, brand or character names anywhere.
